name: LightRAG
summary: Graph-plus-vector RAG framework from HKU with a server, web UI and Ollama-compatible API; pluggable storage backends.
description: LightRAG (EMNLP 2025) builds a knowledge graph and vector index from documents and retrieves over both. It includes `lightrag-server` with a web UI and an Ollama-compatible API, document deletion with graph regeneration, rerankers, citations, selectable chunking strategies, per-role LLM settings, and multimodal parsing (RAG-Anything merged in, via MinerU/Docling). Storage backends include PostgreSQL, MongoDB, OpenSearch and others. Integrates RAGAS for evaluation and Langfuse for tracing. Latest release v1.5.7 (Sep 2026).

agent_access.notes: pip install "lightrag-hku[api]" then run lightrag-server; bring your own LLM and embedding provider.
